name: localsend
title: LocalSend
description: Share files to nearby devices using LocalSend protocol
author: kud

preferences.name: deviceName
preferences.title: Device Name
preferences.description: Name shown to other LocalSend devices (e.g., 'John's Mac')

preferences.name: deviceModel
preferences.title: Device Model
preferences.description: Model of this device (e.g., 'MacBook Pro M3', 'iMac 2023')

preferences.name: httpPort
preferences.title: HTTP Port
preferences.description: Port for receiving files (default: 53318, LocalSend uses 53317)

preferences.name: enableDiscovery
preferences.title: Enable Discovery
preferences.description: Announce this device on the network so others can find it
preferences.label: Make this device discoverable

preferences.name: enableReceive
preferences.title: Enable Receive
preferences.description: Allow this device to receive files from others
preferences.label: Enable receiving files

commands.name: discover-devices
commands.title: Discover Devices
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Discover LocalSend devices on your network

commands.name: send-files
commands.title: Send Files
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Send files to a LocalSend device

commands.name: send-media
commands.title: Send Media
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Send images and videos to a LocalSend device

commands.name: send-text
commands.title: Send Text
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Send text content to a LocalSend device

commands.name: send-clipboard
commands.title: Send Clipboard
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Send clipboard content to a LocalSend device

commands.name: send-folder
commands.title: Send Folder
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Send entire folder to a LocalSend device

commands.name: localsend-status
commands.title: LocalSend Status
commands.subtitle: LocalSend
commands.description: Toggle discovery and receive server from menu bar

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
